version.changelog: Initial release: 5-dimension quality audit framework. Assesses any SKILL.md against Claude best practices with quantified scores and actionable improvements.

llm.summary: The skill is an instruction-only audit tool whose requirements and instructions align with its stated purpose and do not request credentials or install code.

dimensions.detail: Name/description match the behavior: it audits SKILL.md files and supporting resources. The skill requests no binaries, env vars, or installs, which is proportionate for a README/SKILL.md auditor.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions tell the agent to read local SKILL.md files and scan referenced directories (scripts/, references/, assets/) — expected for an audit. It also suggests fetching a remote SKILL.md via curl from raw.githubusercontent.com if no local copy exists; this is coherent with the purpose but is a network operation to be aware of (an auditor will fetch potentially untrusted remote content).
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec and no code files are present (instruction-only). This minimizes on-disk risk and is appropriate for a documentation/audit skill.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required environment variables, no credentials, and no config paths outside standard SKILL.md locations. Requested access is limited to reading skill files, which matches the stated function.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Flags are default (always: false, user-invocable, model invocation enabled). The skill does not request permanent presence or elevated privileges and does not modify other skills' configs.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is a documentation-only auditor and is internally consistent. Before installing or invoking it: be aware it will read SKILL.md files from user-specified paths and standard locations (including ~/.qclaw/...), and may fetch SKILL.md content from raw.githubusercontent.com using curl if instructed — that network fetch is necessary for auditing remote skills but can retrieve untrusted content. No credentials or installs are required. If you allow autonomous agent execution, consider limiting network/file access or review fetched SKILL.md content manually when auditing untrusted repositories.
